# Task 5 real inputs and repairs

Baseline: `d7ea6f619602308ea79bf47337c77edac1beccca`. Fixtures retain archive bytes or exact parsed cells; they are exempt from formatting so no copied source changes silently.

- `empty-template.invalid.txt`: exact pre-repair bytes of `Courses/Coursera/Deep Learning AI course/TensorFlow Deployment/Course 3 - TensorFlow Datasets/Week 1/Examples/tfds_horse-or-human.ipynb`. Only the final empty `cells` array's trailing comma is removed in the archive.
- `inline-raster-excerpt.json`: the original notebook object from `Classes/Johns Hopkins/Sem 1/ML-DL/recitation/DL_Tools_Demo.ipynb`, with `cells` narrowed to original zero-based cell 6. The parsed cell, its source array and embedded PNG payload are unchanged. This source notebook is not edited. Its inline image decodes to 878 by 172 pixels; tests compare original decoded bytes with the sink bytes.
- `repair-0.txt` through `repair-6.txt`: exact complete Markdown files before repair. `source-repairs.json` names their original paths and the only permitted literal substitutions. Regression tests compare the entire repaired source with these substitutions applied, so all other source bytes remain unchanged.
- `notebook-repairs.json`: original SHA-256 of every scoped additional notebook and exact original/replacement JSON string tokens, with zero-based cell/source-line indexes, destinations and evidence. The regression reverses only those tokens and verifies the full original-file hash. Code, outputs, metadata, cell order and JSON formatting are thereby preserved byte-for-byte.

The mixed preparation test reuses unchanged Task 3/4 inputs and their existing provenance. It copies two archive resources directly and unchanged: `Classes/Johns Hopkins/Sem 1/NLP/Week 4/recitation/5-semantics-answers.pdf` and `Classes/Johns Hopkins/Sem 1/NLP/Week 5/lect15-neural.pptx`. It also copies the original Linux reference JPG at `Courses/Programming with Mosh - Docker Tutorial for Beginners/5 Linux Basics/imgs/Linux-Reference.jpg`. The code/notebook fixtures are relocated into the temporary test archive explicitly; the notebook fixture remains the existing exact parsed PyTorch excerpt. Empty Markdown and draft/rename/security cases are synthetic, not invented original note content.

TensorFlow link repairs follow the imported document's existing official source links and verified primary tutorial pages. Destinations are recorded in `notebook-repairs.json`; renamed TFRecord, structured-data/time-series, imbalanced-data and Pandas pages were checked by title and topic. The controller additionally verified Pandas via GitHub GET (`pandas_dataframe.ipynb`, blob `b9d0763e0680277101aa2e696d5cfded1578ad20`). Seven absent GPU images across five notebooks become explicit unavailable labels, retaining original alt text and filenames. No diagrams are invented or downloaded.

The Udemy directory link is the verified upstream course attachment collection at `https://github.com/academind/react-complete-guide-course-resources/tree/main/code/09%20Practice%20Project%20-%20Project%20Management`; controller GET with `ref=main` confirmed ten stages matching the archive.
